title: Investigating the potent antibacterial, antibiofilm, antidiabetic, and antioxidant activities of biosynthesized iron oxide nanoparticles: recyclable catalyst for ammoxidation of aromatic aldehydes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,35844-35858
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04814A, Paper

Asit Kumar Das, Arindam Misra, Md Sattar Ali, Md Sultan Saikh, Subhendu Dhibar, Kalyan Kumar Banerjee, Gourav Ghatak, Dasarath Mal, Manik Shit, Smritikana Biswas
This study reports the green synthesis of Fe3O4@PPE nanoparticles using agricultural waste, showcasing their wide-ranging biological activities and catalytic efficiency in the synthesis of nitriles.
